text:
Shelf after shelf of little red daruma, left by people whose wish came true 🔴

This is Katsuo-ji, up in the hills above Osaka, about 80 minutes' forest walk from Minoh Falls.

You paint in one eye when you make your promise, and the second only when you've kept it.

What would you write on yours? ✍️

#KatsuoJi #Minoh #Osaka #Daruma #JapanTravel
